notablePrerequisites:
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid and Chronatog each have at least one counter on them.
description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Devoted Druid until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Volrath by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Chronatog until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {0}, causing it to get +3/+3 until end of turn, and causing you to skip your next turn.
Repeat.
